expectedIssues: Orders icon is missing from the bottom nav bar
reportedIssues: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is hard-clipped by the viewport: the image, name ('Trattoria Piccol') and delivery price are cut mid-text with no fade/padding, making it look broken rather than scrollable.

The two favorite (heart) buttons on the 'Popular right now' cards have inconsistent styling — the first has a white/light circular background with a dark outline heart, the second has a dark circle with a white heart.
The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza, −20% badge) is cut off by the bottom navigation bar; its title, rating and delivery info are not visible and there is no bottom scroll padding.
The category chip row is clipped at the right edge, showing only a sliver of the next chip with no affordance that the row scrolls.

Delivery-fee and metadata text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') uses light gray on white, likely below WCAG 4.5:1 contrast; icon-only buttons (notification bell, heart) appear to lack visible labels.
The promo banner's decorative circles are clipped awkwardly at the banner's right edge and overlap the rounded corner, creating a slightly unfinished look.

expected.reasoning: No reported issue mentions the Orders icon or bottom navigation bar missing an icon.
